def transform(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    # find separator lines (rows/cols fully 8)
    rlines=[i for i in range(h) if all(x==8 for x in g[i])]
    clines=[j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==8 for i in range(h))]
    def bands(lines,size):
        b=[]; s=0
        for L in lines:
            if L>s: b.append((s,L-1))
            s=L+1
        if s<size: b.append((s,size-1))  # partial band maybe
        return b
    rb=bands(rlines,h); cb=bands(clines,w)
    seeds={}
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j] not in (0,8):
                seeds[g[i][j]]=(next(k for k,(a,b) in enumerate(rb) if a<=i<=b),
                                 next(k for k,(a,b) in enumerate(cb) if a<=j<=b))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i,(a,b) in enumerate(rb):
        for j,(c,d) in enumerate(cb):
            cols={k for k,(bi,bj) in seeds.items() if bi==i}
            rows={k for k,(bi,bj) in seeds.items() if bj==j}
            both=cols&rows
            if both:
                v=next(iter(both)) if len(both)==1 else 6
            elif rows: v=next(iter(rows))
            elif cols: v=next(iter(cols))
            else: continue
            for x in range(a,b+1):
                for y in range(c,d+1):
                    if out[x][y]!=8: out[x][y]=v
    return out

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    R=[i for i in range(h) if all(x==8 for x in g[i])]
    C=[j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==8 for i in range(h))]
    def bands(L,n):
        b=[];s=0
        for x in L:
            if x>s: b.append((s,x-1))
            s=x+1
        if s<n: b.append((s,n-1))
        return b
    rb=bands(R,h); cb=bands(C,w)
    def bi(bands,pos): return next(i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(bands) if a<=pos<=b)
    seeds=[(g[i][j],i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (0,8)]
    fills=[]  # (color, axis, fixed_band_idx, lo_band, hi_band) axis0: vertical stripe in col band; axis1: horizontal
    for c in {s[0] for s in seeds}:
        pts=[(i,j) for cc,i,j in seeds if cc==c]
        from collections import defaultdict
        byr=defaultdict(list); byc=defaultdict(list)
        for i,j in pts: byr[bi(rb,i)].append(j); byc[bi(cb,j)].append(i)
        for r,js in byr.items():
            if len(js)>=2: fills.append((c,1,r,bi(cb,min(js)),bi(cb,max(js))))
        for cl,is_ in byc.items():
            if len(is_)>=2: fills.append((c,0,cl,bi(rb,min(is_)),bi(rb,max(is_))))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for c,ax,f,a0,a1 in fills:
        if ax==0:
            (ca,cbnd),(ra,rbb)=cb[f],rb[a0],rb[a1] if False else (cb[f],(rb[a0],rb[a1]))
            for i in range(rb[a0][0],rb[a1][1]+1):
                for j in range(cbnd[0],cbnd[1]+1):
                    if out[i][j]!=8: out[i][j]=c
        else:
            for i in range(rb[f][0],rb[f][1]+1):
                for j in range(cb[a0][0],cb[a1][1]+1):
                    if out[i][j]!=8: out[i][j]=c
    # intersections: cells covered by two different colors -> 6
    cover={}
    for c,ax,f,a0,a1 in fills:
        cells=[]
        if ax==0:
            for i in range(rb[a0][0],rb[a1][1]+1):
                for j in range(cb[f][0],cb[f][1]+1): cells.append((i,j))
        else:
            for i in range(rb[f][0],rb[f][1]+1):
                for j in range(cb[a0][0],cb[a1][1]+1): cells.append((i,j))
        for p in cells: cover.setdefault(p,set()).add(c)
    for (i,j),cs in cover.items():
        if out[i][j]!=8 and len(cs)>1: out[i][j]=6
    return out
